title: Deeper/broader project capability claims and executable route crosswalk
mode: primary-source web research and plan refinement
scope: Reconcile standalone libdxfrw's published capability and ABI boundaries with local claim authority
Refresh LibreDWG reader/writer operation and effective-version boundaries
Separate FreeCAD DXF importer qualification from converter-mediated DWG qualification
Keep explicit 3D geometry, opaque ACIS/AcDs carriers, semantic solids, and native acceptance distinct

method.kind: Read current primary project documentation/source and reconcile with the local parity plan
method.limitations: GitHub master/main documentation is mutable and was not bound to exact commit SHAs. Documentation establishes declared routes and project policy only; no peer artifact, native application, or independent semantic route was executed.

sources.observed: The project describes the 2.x line as C++17 with a 2.0.0 ABI boundary and separates baseline ASCII/Binary DXF from experimental raw/opaque/ACIS/SAB preservation, experimental DWG read/write, narrow source-compatibility checks, and exact 3D carrier evidence.

sources.revision: Mutable master reviewed 2026-10-18; 0.14 NEWS entry dated 2026-06-27
sources.observed: Current docs describe writing through R2004 and dxf2dwg output through R2000. NEWS says the R2004 encoder writes the newer section/object layout and requested R2007 output falls back to R2010. These statements motivate recording requested versus actual output version; they do not qualify a particular released binary or file.

The docs distinguish an incomplete native C++ DXF importer and optional legacy Python importer. DWG is handed through a selected external converter to DXF, then into the selected importer; this is a composed consumer route, not a direct DWG reader or general 3D-solid oracle.

The LibreCAD inventory labels itself source inventory rather than byte-level conformance; LibreCAD_3 describes DWG import as opt-in/read-only and DWG writing as absent. These sources define migration/product boundaries but are not independent semantic votes.

assessment.planImpact: Strengthens the existing peer and consumer evidence gates with project-level operational-route context. Require the exact artifact and effective output version for peer writer comparisons; isolate direct FreeCAD DXF import from the converter-mediated DWG route; and retain separate evidence rows for explicit geometry, opaque carrier retention, AcDs association, semantic solids, and native acceptance.

implementationReadyChecks: Do not infer file-format support from the C++ standard, ABI boundary, callback inventory, project README, or static source inventory.
For any peer writer run, record exact artifact/build, requested target, actual DWG signature or DXF $ACADVER, process diagnostics, strict reopen, and per-handle/type/owner disposition.
Treat LibreDWG R2004, R2000, and effective R2007-fallback-to-R2010 routes as distinct operation profiles; verify output rather than trusting the request or banner.
Test libdxfrw-produced DXF directly through the selected FreeCAD DXF backend; for DWG, capture and independently validate the fresh converter output before importer evaluation.
Keep generated focused tests and the owning CTest per local slice; defer peer, native platform, fuzz, sanitizer, and broad corpus runs to existing composed checkpoints.
Do not add downloaded/peer drawings as committed fixtures; use existing eligible repository fixtures or local-from-scratch controls.
Keep plan counts at 130/73 and J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
